entries.39a1d2a4c698a880: Precision Parts Manufacturing and Unit Processing Business
entries.7da394471594fa1e: SANKO is a precision parts manufacturer that makes and sells press products, mechatronics products and plastic products, mainly for the automotive sector.
entries.85c09d605a1fd75c: This is the single segment of the company group. The company manufactures and sells press products, mechatronics products and plastic products related to automotive products, housing equipment products, office equipment products and digital consumer electronics products. In Japan, production takes place at the head office plant (Shiojiri, Nagano Prefecture), Horikane Plant, Mita Plant and Azusagawa Plant (all in Nagano Prefecture), and Mino Plant (Kurume, Fukuoka Prefecture); in Thailand, consolidated subsidiary THAI SANKO CO.,LTD. manufactures and sells products. The company discloses Sumitomo Wiring Systems, Ltd. and Denso Corporation as major customers.
